attributes.name: grid
attributes.description: Displays and uses the snapping grid.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Status message displayed by the graph editor.

attributes.name: ports-visible
attributes.description: Keeps attachment plots visible instead of showing them only on hover.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Prevents graph editing while keeping navigation available.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a tp/graph JSON document loaded at initialization.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = "edge", sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = this.activeEdgeDirection, routing: TpGraphEdgeRouting = this.activeEdgeRouting): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Connects existing source and target node IDs using the requested type, ports, direction and routing. Rejects invalid connections, records the change and returns a detached edge copy.

methods.name: addMeasurement(edgeId: string, position = 0.5, label?: string): TpGraphMeasurement
methods.description: Adds a measurement marker to edgeId at a position clamped to 0..1 along the edge; returns its detached record. Throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a node of type at graph coordinates point, snapped to the grid. Uses label or the palette default, records the change and returns a detached copy of the node.

methods.name: animateTransition(transition: TpGraphTransition): Promise<void>
methods.description: Applies node and edge patches to existing IDs, animates their appearance for transition.duration milliseconds (300 by default), then records the change. Resolves after that duration.

methods.name: copy(): boolean
methods.description: Copies the selected graph elements and connecting edges into the editor-local clipboard. Returns false when nothing is selected; does not use the system clipboard.

methods.name: cut(): boolean
methods.description: Copies the selection into the editor-local clipboard, then removes it and connected edges as an undoable change. Returns false when readonly or nothing is selected.

methods.name: exportJson(pretty = true): string
methods.description: Returns the graph serialized as JSON; pretty uses two-space indentation, while false produces compact JSON.

methods.name: exportSvg(): string
methods.description: Returns a standalone SVG of the graph with resolved styles and content bounds; throws when the canvas is not ready.

methods.name: importJson(source: string): void
methods.description: Parses and validates a JSON graph, replaces the current graph and emits tp-graph-import. Invalid JSON or graph data throws before replacement.

methods.name: moveMeasurement(id: string, position: number): void
methods.description: Moves the marker identified by id to a relative edge position clamped to 0..1; throws when the marker is unknown.

methods.name: paste(): string | null
methods.description: Duplicates the editor-local clipboard with new IDs and an offset, then selects the copies. Returns the first pasted ID, or null when readonly or no clipboard content is available.

methods.name: reconnectEdge(edgeId: string, endpoint: "source" | "target", nodeId: string, port: TpGraphPort): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Moves the source or target endpoint of edgeId to nodeId and port after connection validation; returns a detached copy of the updated edge.

methods.name: redo(): boolean
methods.description: Restores the next undone graph snapshot and returns true; returns false when redo history is empty.

methods.name: registerPalette(palette: TpGraphPalette): void
methods.description: Registers or replaces a shape palette by its ID and refreshes the palette UI. Requires a nonempty ID and at least one shape.

methods.name: registerSimulator(name: string, simulator: TpGraphSimulator): void
methods.description: Registers or replaces the simulator function associated with name for subsequent step(name) calls.

methods.name: removeElement(id: string): void
methods.description: Removes the node, edge or measurement identified by id; removing a node also removes its connected edges. Updates selection and records an undoable change.

methods.name: resetZoom(): void
methods.description: Restores magnification to 1 (100%) without changing graph data.

methods.name: setCommentColor(id: string, color: TpGraphCommentColor): void
methods.description: Changes the color of a comment node and records the change; throws for an unknown comment or unsupported color.

methods.name: setEdgeDirection(edgeId: string, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection): void
methods.description: Changes an existing edge direction and the default for new edges; throws for an unknown edge or a direction unsupported by this editor.

methods.name: setEdgeOrthogonal(edgeId: string, elbows: 1 | 2 | 3, departure: "horizontal" | "vertical", turns: "alternating" | "same" = "alternating"): void
methods.description: Uses orthogonal routing with 1, 2 or 3 elbows and a horizontal or vertical departure. The turns choice applies to two elbows; throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: setEdgeRouting(edgeId: string, routing: TpGraphEdgeRouting): void
methods.description: Changes an existing edge routing mode and the default for new edges; throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: setElementLabel(id: string, label: string): void
methods.description: Sets the trimmed label of a node, edge or measurement by ID; empty clears the label. Throws for an unknown element.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates and clones the supplied graph, clears selection and rerenders it. After initialization, a changed graph is recorded in undo history; invalid graphs throw before replacement.

methods.name: setTitle(title: string): void
methods.description: Trims and stores the graph title, then records an undoable change; an empty string removes visible title text.

methods.name: setZoom(value: number): void
methods.description: Sets a positive finite magnification factor, clamped to the supported zoom range. A value of 1 means 100%; invalid inputs throw TypeError.

methods.name: step(simulatorName: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Runs the simulator registered as simulatorName on a graph snapshot, awaits its animated transition and emits tp-graph-simulation-step. Throws for an unknown simulator.

methods.name: undo(): boolean
methods.description: Restores the preceding graph snapshot and returns true; returns false when undo history is empty.

methods.name: unregisterPalette(id: string): void
methods.description: Removes the palette with the supplied ID and selects a remaining shape if needed; does not remove existing graph nodes.

methods.name: zoomIn(): void
methods.description: Increases magnification by the configured zoom factor, up to the supported maximum.

methods.name: zoomOut(): void
methods.description: Decreases magnification by the configured zoom factor, down to the supported minimum.

events.name: tp-graph-change
events.description: Emitted after a recorded graph mutation, JSON edit, undo or redo. reason identifies the operation and graph contains the resulting snapshot.

events.name: tp-graph-error
events.description: Emitted when loading src or creating/reconnecting an edge fails. operation identifies the failed action; src is included only for load-src.

events.name: tp-graph-export
events.description: Emitted after the graph export has been saved; graph contains the exported graph snapshot.

events.name: tp-graph-import
events.description: Emitted after importJSON validates and installs a graph; graph contains the imported snapshot.

events.name: tp-graph-selection-change
events.description: Emitted when the selection is synchronized. id is the primary selection or null, and ids lists all selected element identifiers.

events.name: tp-graph-simulation-step
events.description: Emitted after a registered simulator step and its transition animation complete; simulator is its registered name and graph is the resulting snapshot.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-editor>` element implements the <tp-icon name="graph-editor" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Graph editor functionality: edits and animates domain-specific graphs.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Drag | Drag a shape from the palette onto the canvas to create a node. |
| Select | Select and move nodes, connect their ports, and select links to edit them. |
| Using the component | Use the toolbar for undo, redo, zoom, import and export. |
| Using the component | The `language-json` toolbar button shows or hides a source editor below the palette and canvas. |
| Graph JSON | Synchronization is explicit: after editing the JSON, use the `sync` button at the end of the **Graph JSON** header to apply it to the graph. |
| Using the component | If the code has not been edited, the same button copies the current graph into the code editor. |
| Using the component | Invalid JSON leaves the canvas unchanged and displays a validation message. |
| Drag | Drag a shape from the palette and drop it on the canvas to create a node. |
| Click | Clicking an empty part of the canvas only clears the selection. |
| Drag | Drag a node by its body to move it. |
| Using the component | When an existing link is selected, choosing another link mode in the palette changes that link immediately. |
| Using the component | Without a selected link, the choice applies to the next link created. |
| Hover | Hover or select a node to reveal its four attachment ports. |
| Drag | Drag from the exact source port to the exact target port to create an edge. |
| Using the component | A dashed preview follows the pointer, but releasing it over the node body does not create a connection. |
| Hover | Hover or select an edge to reveal a handle at each endpoint. |
| Drag | Drag either handle onto the exact destination port to reconnect that endpoint. |
| Using the component | Domain rules are applied again, so an invalid endpoint is rejected without changing the edge. |
| Drag | Drag the body of an edge to move the complete segment. |
| Using the component | This disconnects both endpoints. |
| Using the component | The endpoint handles can then reconnect the floating edge wherever needed. |
| Measurement | Drag **Measurement** from the annotation palette and drop its small square directly on a link. |
| Using the component | The point remains attached while nodes and bends move. |
| Drag | Drag the square along the link to reposition it, then double-click it to give it a name. |
| Using the component | Removing a node also removes its incident edges. |
| Cut | The **Cut** button provides the equivalent toolbar action while retaining the element in the editor clipboard. |
| Copy | Use **Copy**, **Cut**, and **Paste** on the selected element. |
| Undo | A pasted node is offset from its source, with a larger offset for each consecutive paste. **Undo** and **Redo** navigate up to 100 graph changes. |
| :tp-icon:{name="arrow-expand-vertical" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="arrow-collapse-vertical" size="1.25em"} Expand / Collapse | Expands or collapses every palette group. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="redo" size="1.25em"} Undo / Redo | Navigates graph changes. |
| :tp-icon:{name="select" size="1.25em"} Select area | Toggles rectangular multi-selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="content-copy" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="content-cut" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="content-paste" size="1.25em"} Copy / Cut / Paste | Copies, removes, or pastes selected graph elements. |
| :tp-icon:{name="text-short" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="format-title" size="1.25em"} Label / Graph title | Edits the selected label or document title. |
| :tp-icon:{name="magnify-minus-outline" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="magnify-plus-outline" size="1.25em"} Zoom out / Zoom in | Changes the canvas scale. |
| :tp-icon:{name="grid" size="1.25em"} Grid | Shows or hides the snapping grid. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-upload" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="file-download" size="1.25em"} Import / Export | Loads or downloads the graph as JSON. |
| :tp-icon:{name="language-json" size="1.25em"} Graph JSON | Shows or hides the JSON editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="1.25em"} Editor toolbar | Shows or hides the JSON code editor toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="sync" size="1.25em"} Synchronize | Applies edited JSON or copies the graph into the JSON editor. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Delete</kbd> / <kbd>Backspace</kbd> | Remove the selected node, edge or measurement point. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> | Copy the selected element. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>X</kbd> | Cut the selected element. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> | Paste the copied or cut element. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
